name: starcharts-summon
description: Cloudflare Worker proxy from the Starcharts app to Azure AI Foundry gpt-image-1.5, storing generated PNGs in R2.

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --var SIGIL_HASH:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --var SIGIL_BRANCH:$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) --var SIGIL_DIRTY:$(git diff --quiet HEAD && echo false || echo true) --var SIGIL_BUILT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
